name: developgravity/lua-extension
description: A PHP extension embedding Lua 5.5 as a sandbox for untrusted code, with portable resource limits, call-scoped coroutines and a host-backed virtual filesystem.

configure-options.name: enable-luaext-debug
configure-options.description: Build with internal assertions and the Lua API checker enabled.

configure-options.name: enable-luaext-sanitize
configure-options.description: Comma-separated list of sanitizers to build with, for example address,undefined.
